from_quote: In South Carolina they are biennial as is proposed in the federal government.
rationale: Names the term proposed for the federal House of Representatives as biennial, matching this clause's "chosen every second Year."

from_quote: Each house is, as it necessarily must be, the judge of the elections, qualifications, and returns of its members
rationale: Restates the opening words of this clause, "Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members," with two of the nouns in a different order.
to_quote: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members
